description: Generate a character mockup sheet (21:9, 4 panels: full-body front·profile·back·portrait). From a real-person photo (photoPaths) and/or a text description. Engine: Seedream (BytePlus) with a Gemini fallback. The result is saved as an asset in the library. Pass its id to create_character as imageAssetId to cast it — the sheet gets the anti-moderation grain at that moment.

assetName.description: name for the @mention; without it the sheet is called "mockup" (then mockup-2, …) — this tool has no character name to build one from

description.description: who it is; required when there are no photos; write the style right here

photoPaths.description: paths to photos of the person (up to 14)

name: generate_mocap
